name: Plate CLXXXIV: The Platonic Solid
description: The five regular bodies of the Timaeus, which Plato gave to Fire, Air, Earth, Water and the Heavens. Struck in Nigredo: the blackening, where every matter is first dissolved. Degree of Initiate, rank 285 of the folio. “V · I · T · R · I · O · L”: Visit the interior of the earth; by rectifying you will find the hidden stone.
